release_notes:
Fix orders getting stuck indefinitely with some suppliers

An order could be marked as sent to the supplier but never move
forward or show up for review, with no indication anything had gone
wrong -- it just stopped appearing anywhere. This happened when a
supplier confirmed receiving the order but didn't return a tracking
reference for it, a combination the dispatch process had no way to
handle, so the order was silently skipped on every run after that.

These orders are now flagged for manual review instead of
disappearing, so they can be checked and completed by hand rather
than sitting unprocessed indefinitely.
